_comment: Daywalker voiced dialogue, played by the Dialogue autoload (scripts/audio/dialogue.gd): Dialogue.play(id), or Dialogue.play_group(prefix) for a random variant (e.g. 'bark_bite_'). duration = subtitle seconds (audio length + 0.6). priority: 0 menu idle, 1 barks/taunts, 2 comms, 3 boss. cooldown = seconds before the same id may play again.

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: You've sharpened that thing three times.

lines.speaker: sol
lines.text: Fourth time's for luck.

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: Your blood sample just ate my control sample.

lines.speaker: sol
lines.text: Sounds about right. Did it say thank you?

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: Reyes left another voicemail. She sounds... thorough.

lines.speaker: sol
lines.text: She's a good cop. That's the problem.

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: You could sleep, you know. Like a normal person.

lines.speaker: sol
lines.text: Tried it once. Didn't take.

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: The Court's throwing a party on the Velvet Mile tonight.

lines.speaker: sol
lines.text: Then I reckon I'm crashing it.

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: Hunger's at forty percent. I'm writing that down.

lines.speaker: sol
lines.text: Write it in pencil, Doc.

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: Rain's coming down hard up top.

lines.speaker: sol
lines.text: Good. Hides the smell. Theirs and mine.

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: If you die out there, I'm keeping the coat.

lines.speaker: sol
lines.text: It wouldn't fit you. Barely fits me.

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: Somebody broke the Accord. Wren's husband, bitten. A Court duke, torn to pieces.

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: Both sides smell you on it. Lucien's called the Red Curfew.

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: Three nights, Sol. Stay alive, and find who's framing you.

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: Comms are up. I can hear you breathing, so that's a good start.

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: Pick your steel, pick your ground. Every district's crawling tonight.

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: Dropping you in. Hit what you can before the Curfew closes.

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: Out of the tunnels and into the rain. Try to bring the coat back dry.

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: That signal's a nest. Clear it, and whatever they're guarding is yours.

lines.speaker: sol
lines.text: Mm. Vintage.

lines.speaker: sol
lines.text: That'll hold me.

lines.speaker: sol
lines.text: Too slow.

lines.speaker: sol
lines.text: Missed me, darlin'.

lines.speaker: sol
lines.text: Okay. That one hurt.

lines.speaker: sol
lines.text: Need blood. Now.

lines.speaker: sol
lines.text: Can't... hold it... back!

lines.speaker: sol
lines.text: Feel that? Stronger.

lines.speaker: sol
lines.text: Gettin' the hang of this.

lines.speaker: sol
lines.text: Eclipse steel. Somebody's gonna miss this.

lines.speaker: sol
lines.text: Sun's up. Run, little bats.

lines.speaker: sol
lines.text: Here comes the night shift.

lines.speaker: sol
lines.text: Stay down.

lines.speaker: sol
lines.text: Who's next?

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: Red Curfew's closing. Get inside the ring, Sol, or it gets inside you.

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: Ring's almost shut. Move. Now.

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: Nest's clear. Nice work. Grab what's shiny and go.

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: That's one less hole full of teeth.

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: Your blood's crashing. Find a neck. Well, not any neck.

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: Full moon's up. The Pack is out in force. Don't let them flank you.

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: Sun's coming. The bloodsuckers scramble. You don't.

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: Dawn's up. Hunt's done. Come home, Sol. I'll put the kettle on.

lines.speaker: lucien
lines.text: Citizens of Port Vesper. The Red Curfew is in effect. Stay indoors... and stay delicious.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: All units, Curfew zone is sealed. Man in the long coat, do not engage. I mean it.

lines.speaker: vampire
lines.text: Half-breed! You smell like a church.

lines.speaker: vampire
lines.text: The Count wants you alive. Mostly.

lines.speaker: vampire
lines.text: Come here, Daywalker. Let me taste you.

lines.speaker: court
lines.text: The Velvet Court sends its regards.

lines.speaker: court
lines.text: You're terribly underdressed for this party.

lines.speaker: court
lines.text: Kneel, and Lucien might let you keep your head.

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: That howl's the Alpha. Wren's firstborn. He's big, and he brought family.

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: Alpha's down. The Pack won't forget that.

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: Look at us. Two fast men in nice coats. Only one walks out tonight.

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: Faster... than me? Nobody's... faster...

lines.speaker: seraphine
lines.text: My darling abomination. Show the Daywalker what his blood has made.

lines.speaker: seraphine
lines.text: You killed my child. I'll make another... from you.
